title: A Sudoku Solver in APL
summary: A Dyalog demonstration of developing a Sudoku solver in APL, using an algorithm by Arthur Whitney with performance work by John Scholes. The narration steps through the array-oriented solution.
why: Strongly recommended as a beautiful demonstration that APL can be read and reasoned about step by step.

quote.text: I've always liked this video, where one of the Dyalog developers effortlessly writes a Sudoku solver in APL
